selection.algorithm: Permute sorted gold-passage groups; greedily fill dev20 then train10; rest val10/test80
selection.caveat: All100 previously inspected; test80 excludes only this round optimizer data, not historical exposure

prior_exposure: All100 previously inspected; same80 used in earlier experiments; exploratory only
target: BM25 query-generation instruction; not reader optimization

task_generation.adapter: One raw user message; historical default renders byte-for-byte identically
task_generation.invalid_output: Keep original response; score as failed query generation with empty ranking, no repairs

optimizer.metric: BM25 nDCG@10 from exact per-k RRF60 of three rewrites plus original
optimizer.proposer_inputs: Train questions, generated query traces and measured rank/format feedback only; no reference answers, passage text, relevance IDs or test questions
optimizer.feedback: nDCG10, labeled-passage rank or absence, output-line count, duplicate rewrites; no invented explanations
optimizer.checkpoint: Durable gateway per request; predictor text cache; native optimizer trial logs; final instruction frozen before test generation

retrieval.query_fusion: Each query top k -> equal RRF60 -> final k, same as Meeting11
retrieval.hybrid: Each query first fuses BM25/dense top100 at0.5/0.5; query RRF is separate
retrieval.dense: Pinned MiniLM256 from Meeting11; saved corpus/question vectors reused

comparisons.transfer: Frozen instruction unchanged on dense and hybrid; no retuning
comparisons.primary: Six paired nDCG@10 optimized-minus-default/manual contrasts across3 backends; one Holm6 family
comparisons.secondary: Hit/Recall/MRR at5/8/10 descriptive; original-question rows descriptive
